decision: Ship at WARNING without autofix. The private frontend corpus has no natural findings and no inspected false positives; the rule is preventive within the visible single-tree boundary.

existingOwners.oxlintNative: none; react/void-dom-elements-no-children and jsx-a11y rules do not model parent/descendant content

reproduction.method: Render each tree with react-dom/server renderToStaticMarkup, reparse the markup with a spec-compliant HTML parser and compare serializations.

corpora.scope: frontend application JSX/TSX at the current development head
every added or modified JSX/TSX file version in every application commit since the repository import

labels.falseNegativeCause: A framework link component wraps a design-system button component; both render interactive elements, but the nesting crosses component boundaries the rule deliberately treats as opaque.

blindSpots.note: About two thirds of opening tags are components, so most real nestings in this corpus are outside the rule's reach by design.

performance.input: 902-file private corpus, single Oxlint thread, five interleaved pairs
performance.baseline: existing intrinsic JSX rule no-password-get-form alone

limitations: Only intrinsic nesting visible in one JSX tree is judged; component, alias, variable, prop and arbitrary-call boundaries are opaque.
No natural positives were observed, so fixture results do not establish field precision or recall.
Private source, paths and revisions are withheld; only aggregates are recorded.
